name: Date picker
description: A date field typed one part at a time, with a calendar in a popover, for one date or a range.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon.

props.name: value
props.description: The date (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the date changes.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Earliest allowed date.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Latest allowed date.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks days that cannot be chosen in the calendar.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Smallest unit shown. Finer than day adds time segments when the value has a time.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: Date the calendar opens on and the segments count from while empty.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a date before a form submits.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia outline and the error message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components DatePicker (name, isOpen, onOpenChange, shouldCloseOnSelect...).

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid.

props.name: value
props.description: The range (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (value: { start: DateValue; end: DateValue } | null) => void
props.description: Called when the range changes.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: Months shown in the popover calendar.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: Let a range run across unavailable days.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Accepts the same props as DatePicker otherwise.
